settings.headline: The trade proposition.
settings.body:
Account pricing. Volume pricing tiers for clinics, salons, and aesthetic practices. Specific rates discussed at the enquiry stage.

Clinic sizes. Bulk sizes for the products clinics use at volume. Beyond the consumer 30g and 35ml ranges. Specific SKUs discussed at the enquiry stage.

Supply consistency. UK formulation, UK supply chain, account-level inventory visibility. The supply continuity clinics need from a long-term partner.

settings.headline: Built for aesthetic practitioners specifically.
settings.body: Senseless is formulated for aesthetic procedures. The product range, the recommendation system, and the trade infrastructure are all built around that specialism. The practitioners Senseless trade suits: aesthetic clinics running injectables, microneedling, and laser; SPMU artists working sustained sittings; waxing salons handling regular body work; and dermatology-adjacent practices using topical preparation for their procedures. If you're a medical or general healthcare practice using numbing for non-aesthetic procedures, Senseless isn't formulated for that context — Emla, Ametop, or another medical preparation is the right product.

settings.headline: Professional Strength is available to all. Trade is the clinic relationship.
settings.body: Senseless doesn't gate Professional Strength behind practitioner credentials. It's sold direct-to-consumer on the same site, at the same product page. That's deliberate — the system is built on transparency, not on professional-only access. Trade exists for a different reason: clinics working at volume need account pricing, bulk sizes, supply consistency, and direct support. Those operational needs are what trade actually delivers, not exclusive access to the product range.

settings.title: Submit an enquiry.
settings.body: The form below. Tell us about your practice, the products you're interested in, your typical order volume.

settings.title: Account review.
settings.body: We confirm your practice meets the trade criteria (UK-based aesthetic practitioner, registered business). Standard checks, usually quick.

settings.title: Account setup.
settings.body: Wholesale pricing, payment terms, and ordering portal access confirmed. You're ready to order.

settings.title: First order.
settings.body: Place via the trade portal. Direct supply from there.

settings.question: What's the minimum order volume?
settings.answer: Minimums vary by SKU and account tier. Confirmed at the enquiry stage based on your practice's typical usage.

settings.question: What sizes are available wholesale?
settings.answer: The full consumer range, plus bulk clinic sizes on the most-used SKUs (typically the Professional Strength tier). Specific options discussed at enquiry.

settings.question: How fast is delivery?
settings.answer: UK-based supply, standard delivery windows. Specific timing confirmed at order confirmation per shipment.

settings.question: Do you offer payment terms?
settings.answer: Yes — payment terms available for approved accounts. Discussed at account setup.

settings.question: Can I order sample sizes for staff training?
settings.answer: Yes. Sample sizes available for new accounts to evaluate the product range before placing volume orders.

settings.question: Do you support clinic-branded display or marketing?
settings.answer: We work with clinics on point-of-display where appropriate. Specific marketing collaborations discussed case-by-case.
